title: Setup audit: the `audit:log` browser offers `sys_audit_log`'s list views as presets and an "Open as list" link, so Setup can keep one audit entry (item 1 of objectstack#23803, the objectui half of objectstack#23890)
body:
Filing gate ④: a cross-layer split. This is the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23890 (item 1 of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23803, filed by the epic PM from the 2026-10-16 Setup review under the maintainer's 「全部立卡」). It was filed by the triage seat (objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) when routing #23890. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` seat, one PR.

## Target (item 1 of objectstack#23803, verbatim)

"One audit entry: "Audit Log" opens the browser (filters by action, object, actor, date); the record list's views (Writes, Auth, …) become the browser's presets; the `sys_audit_log` list stays reachable from the browser's "Open as list" link, not from the nav."

## Where

- The browser is this repo's console component `audit:log`, registered at `apps/console/src/registerSystemComponents.tsx:80`.
- The list views it should offer as presets are declared by objectstack's `plugin-audit` on `sys_audit_log` (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-audit-log.object.ts`: `writes_only` at `:60`, `auth_events` at `:73`, and the rest). Read them from the served object metadata; ⛔ do not copy them as literals.

## Done when

- The browser offers each served list view of `sys_audit_log` as a preset filter.
- An "Open as list" link reaches the `sys_audit_log` list.
- Then objectstack#23890 (`domain:services`, blocked on this card) removes `nav_audit_logs` from Setup's nav, once this card is installable at objectstack's `.objectui-sha`.

## Grade

p2, as objectstack#23803 and #23890.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, all states: `audit log browser presets open as list sys_audit_log Setup navigation one audit entry` returned 1 hit, objectui#12475 (closed, a different gate on the History and Audit tabs).

Dedupe words: audit log browser presets; Open as list sys_audit_log; one audit entry Setup.
